_comment: Copy this file to aging-report.config.json (same folder) and fill in the values. Do NOT commit the real file - it holds the mailbox password.

_brevo.note: Previous sender. Brevo was dropped 24-25 Nov 2026: supplychain1.ie SPF (v=spf1 a mx -all) does not authorise Brevo, so messages hard-failed SPF and were binned. The domain's own server remote.a-i-m.ie IS authorised. To go back to Brevo, add include:spf.brevo.com + Brevo DKIM to the domain DNS (via a-i-m.ie) and verify the sender in Brevo.
